name: ToolScan
description: ToolScan is a benchmark designed to identify and characterize error patterns in large language models (LLMs) when performing tool-use tasks. It provides a dataset of queries from diverse environments to test for seven newly characterized error patterns, enabling detailed analysis beyond simple success rates.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is gaining attention for diagnosing tool-use failure modes, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on identifying seven specific error patterns in LLM tool-use outputs; open-sourced evaluation framework.
